quarterly_data.signal: Customer TychoBio (an AI drug discovery company): PacBio and TychoBio announced a collaboration to generate full-length RNA data that TychoBio will use to train models for RNA therapy design. Under the agreement TychoBio plans to use PacBio HiFi sequencing and Kinnex long-read RNA sequencing to generate data from more than 10,000 samples, building datasets linking the design of steric blocking antisense oligonucleotides (SBOs) to their effects across the transcriptome, with plans to expand to siRNA and other RNA-targeting compounds. CEO Mark Van Oene: the work with TychoBio, like the collaboration with Basecamp Research, highlights the critical value high-quality sequencing data plays in generating the foundational data that will power biological modeling in the AI ecosystem.
